name: omniapi-mcp
display_name: OmniAPI — Image · Audio · Text · Speech · Music · Agents
description: One MCP server for image generation/editing, audio transcription, text completion and multi-turn chat, speech synthesis, music generation, and dispatching headless coding agents — across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, ElevenLabs, and Suno (via kie.ai).
long_description:
OmniAPI is a unified MCP server that routes requests to multiple AI provider APIs behind one interface — five modalities plus agent dispatch in 19 tools:

- **Image generation & editing** (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5 / 2 / 1.5 / 1-mini, Google Nano Banana) — text-to-image, mask editing, multi-image compositing, up to 4K, multiple candidates per call.
- **Audio transcription** (OpenAI gpt-transcribe) — plus subtitles, word-level timestamps and speaker diarization via the deprecated whisper-1 / gpt-4o-transcribe family.
- **Text / chat completion** (OpenAI GPT-6 & GPT-5.x, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and the OpenRouter long tail) — tier aliases cheap / standard / strong, reasoning controls, structured output, and function calling.
- **Speech synthesis / TTS** (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts / tts-1, ElevenLabs, Gemini TTS) — natural-language tone control and fine voice tuning.
- **Music generation** (Suno V6 via kie.ai; ElevenLabs Music) — full songs with vocals, plus action-based editing (extend / cover / stems / vocals), lyrics, WAV / MP4 rendering, and ElevenLabs composition plans.
- **Multi-turn chat** (`chat`) — conversations kept in a local store; pass the returned conversation_id to continue, switch models between turns.
- **Agent dispatch** (`run_agent` / `get_run` / `list_runs` / `cancel_run`) — hand a task to a headless coding agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI, routed by model) working in a folder you choose, then follow or resume it.

Model rosters are live: every provider is asked what is online at startup, merged with a curated pricing/capability overlay. Call list_available_models(modality=...) to see the current list, including deprecation and shutdown dates.

A single OpenAI API key unlocks image, transcription, text and speech. Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek and OpenRouter add text models. Music needs a kie.ai key (Suno) or a paid ElevenLabs plan.

Long jobs (Suno music, high-quality / 4K images) return a task_id ticket and keep running in the background — fetch them with get_job_result — so they never hit the client's tool-call timeout.

This extension is the stdio MCP server on its own. The full OmniAPI — a local daemon with a web board, dispatch, a works wall, a chat UI (file attachments, retries and branches, image generation inside the conversation) and the `omni` CLI — is in the repository.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images from a text prompt (OpenAI gpt-image, Google Nano Banana); supports 4K, transparent backgrounds, explicit aspect ratios, and multiple candidates (n).

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a text instruction and optional mask; supports input_fidelity, multi-image compositing, and local file paths. OpenAI gpt-image models only.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe audio to text (gpt-transcribe by default); subtitles, word-level timestamps and speaker diarization are available on the deprecated whisper-1 / gpt-4o-transcribe family (shutdown 2027-02-26).

tools.name: complete_text
tools.description: Run a text/chat completion with OpenAI (GPT-6 / GPT-5.x), Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek or OpenRouter. Accepts the tier aliases cheap / standard / strong, plus reasoning controls, structured output, and function calling.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Multi-turn chat with any text model (tiers cheap / standard / strong or a model id). Pass back the returned conversation_id for the next turn; conversations are stored and appear in the OmniAPI GUI under /chat. Files are attached in the GUI; continuing such a conversation here, the model can still read them.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech from text (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts / tts-1, ElevenLabs, or Gemini TTS) with tone control and fine voice tuning.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate music from a text description (Suno V6 family via kie.ai, or ElevenLabs Music); supports instrumental, custom mode, and vocal gender.

tools.name: edit_music
tools.description: Transform existing audio with Suno. Pick one action: extend, cover, upload_extend, add_instrumental, add_vocals, or separate_vocals — each needs a different subset of audio_id / task_id / upload_url / prompt / style / title / tags.

tools.name: music_lyrics
tools.description: Song lyrics via Suno. action='generate' writes lyrics from a prompt; action='timestamped' returns word-level timings for a track you already generated (task_id + audio_id).

tools.name: music_utility
tools.description: Render a Suno track you already generated into another format. action='convert_to_wav' or 'create_music_video'; both need task_id + audio_id.

tools.name: compose_music
tools.description: ElevenLabs composition-plan workflow. action='create_plan' returns an editable section-level plan; action='compose' renders audio from a prompt or an edited plan.

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Dispatch a task to a headless coding agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI — chosen by model) in a working directory; returns a run id right away. Supports resume.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a run's state, result, cost and (optionally) its events.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List recent agent runs with state, model, turns and cost.

tools.name: list_available_models
tools.description: List every model OmniAPI can call across all modalities (text, image, transcription, speech, music) with provider, online status, pricing, deprecation/shutdown info and the tier aliases. Filter with modality; flags: include_retired, include_snapshots, refresh.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check whether the MCP server and its providers are reachable.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Return server metadata (version, capabilities, default model, etc.).

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a long-running generation that returned a task_id ticket (Suno music, high-quality / 4K images). Poll until status is no longer 'running'.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.description: Your OpenAI API key (sk-...). Required — unlocks image, transcription, text (GPT-5.x), and speech (gpt-4o-mini-tts).

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API Key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional. Add an ElevenLabs key to use ElevenLabs voices for generate_speech, and ElevenLabs Music (paid plan) for music generation. Leave blank to use OpenAI TTS only.

kie_api_key.title: kie.ai API Key (optional)
kie_api_key.description: Optional. Add a kie.ai key to generate and transform music with Suno (generate_music, edit_music, music_lyrics, music_utility). Leave blank to disable Suno music.

default_model.title: Default Image Model
default_model.description: Default model for generate_image (and the fallback model for edit_image).

storage_path.title: Storage Path
storage_path.description: Absolute path to the folder where generated images and audio are saved (kept across extension updates). Change it to any folder you like via the picker.
